context: Call 0800-555-2265 immediately. We'll freeze the card

name: Transaction Monitoring
description: A capability enabling customers to regularly review and monitor their account transactions to detect and report suspicious activity.
context: Monitor transactions regularly
Report suspicious activity immediately

name: Interest Rate Change Drivers
description: Explains that the Bank of England changes its base rate in response to economic conditions, and FirstUK passes these changes to customers while maintaining a fixed 2.5% margin.
context: Why do interest rates change?
Bank of England (BoE) changes its base rate based on economic conditions. We pass these changes to customers (our 2.5% margin stays fixed).

name: FirstUK Rate Change Frequency and Notification
description: Clarifies that FirstUK changes rates monthly, typically mid-month, and notifies customers via email before changes take effect.
context: When does FirstUK change rates?
Monthly (typically mid-month). We notify customers via email before changes take effect.

name: Rate Lock-In Options
aliases: Can I lock in a rate
description: Advises that SmartSaver operates on a variable rate basis, and directs customers seeking fixed rates to consider fixed-rate bonds launching in 2026.
context: Can I lock in a rate?
SmartSaver is variable. For fixed rates, consider fixed-rate bonds (coming 2026).

name: Interest Calculation Method
description: Describes the interest calculation methodology: daily calculation with monthly payment. Provides a worked example showing £10,000 at 4.50% AER earning approximately £37.50 per month.
context: How is interest calculated?
Daily calculation, paid monthly. Example: £10,000 at 4.50% AER earns ~£37.50 per month.

name: SmartSaver Account
description: A variable-rate savings product offered by FirstUK Bank. The product features daily interest calculation with monthly payment, and rates are adjusted monthly in line with Bank of England base rate changes.
context: SmartSaver is variable.
Daily calculation, paid monthly.

name: Fixed-Rate Bond
description: A fixed-rate savings product coming to FirstUK in 2026, offered as an alternative for customers seeking to lock in a rate rather than hold variable-rate savings.
context: For fixed rates, consider fixed-rate bonds (coming 2026).

name: Variable Interest Rate Feature
description: A feature of SmartSaver that allows interest rates to adjust monthly in line with Bank of England base rate movements, with FirstUK maintaining a fixed 2.5% margin.
context: SmartSaver is variable.
We pass these changes to customers (our 2.5% margin stays fixed).

name: Monthly Email Rate Change Notification
description: FirstUK notifies customers via email before rate changes take effect, typically mid-month, ensuring transparency and advance notice of interest rate adjustments.
context: We notify customers via email before changes take effect.

name: Daily Interest Calculation with Monthly Payment
description: Interest on SmartSaver is calculated daily and paid to the customer account on a monthly basis, providing regular interest income.
context: Daily calculation, paid monthly.

name: Bank of England Base Rate Pass-Through with Fixed Margin
description: FirstUK maintains a fixed 2.5% margin on SmartSaver products. Changes to the Bank of England base rate are passed through to customers while this margin remains constant.
context: Bank of England (BoE) changes its base rate based on economic conditions. We pass these changes to customers (our 2.5% margin stays fixed).

name: FirstUK Branch Locations
description: FAQ item detailing the geographic distribution of FirstUK's 12 branches across the United Kingdom and Ireland, including major locations in London (Canary Wharf and Head Office at Threadneedle Street), North West (Manchester, Liverpool), Midlands (Birmingham), North East (Leeds), South (Bristol, Southampton), Scotland (Edinburgh, Glasgow), East (Norwich), and Ireland (Belfast).
context: 12 branches across the UK
London: Canary Wharf + Head Office (Threadneedle Street)
Scotland: Edinburgh, Glasgow
Ireland: Belfast

name: Branch Opening Hours
description: FAQ item specifying the standard operating hours for FirstUK branches: Monday to Friday 09:00–17:00, Saturday 09:00–13:00, with branches closed on Sundays and bank holidays.
context: Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00, Saturday 09:00–13:00
closed Sundays/bank holidays

name: Branch Walk-In Access Policy
description: FAQ item confirming that customers may visit FirstUK branches without an appointment on a walk-in basis. For complex matters, customers are advised to book an appointment by calling 0800-555-2265.
context: Yes, walk-ins welcome
For complex matters, book an appointment (call 0800-555-2265)

name: FirstUK Bank Regulatory Status
description: Confirms that FirstUK Bank is regulated by both the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and the Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA), establishing the bank's regulatory standing and customer protection framework.
context: Is FirstUK Bank regulated?
Yes, by the FCA (Financial Conduct Authority) and PRA (Prudential Regulation Authority).

name: FSCS Deposit Protection Coverage
description: Explains that customer deposits held with FirstUK Bank are protected by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS) up to a limit of £85,000 per depositor in the event of bank failure.
context: What if FirstUK Bank fails?
Your deposits (up to £85,000) are protected by FSCS.

name: FirstUK Bank FCA Register Verification
description: Provides guidance for customers to verify FirstUK Bank's legitimacy by checking the FCA register at www.register.fca.org.uk, enabling customers to confirm the bank's authorised status.
context: How can I verify FirstUK is real?
Check FCA register at www.register.fca.org.uk (search "FirstUK Bank").

name: Data Breach Concern Escalation
description: Instructs customers with data breach concerns to contact the bank's Data Protection Officer at dpo@firstuk.bank for investigation and resolution of data protection incidents.
context: What if I have a data breach concern?
Contact our Data Protection Officer: dpo@firstuk.bank

name: FSCS Deposit Protection Scheme
description: Contractual provision establishing that customer deposits are protected by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme up to £85,000, providing statutory protection in the event of FirstUK Bank's insolvency.
context: Your deposits (up to £85,000) are protected by FSCS.

name: Data Protection Officer Contact Right
description: Establishes the customer's right to contact the bank's Data Protection Officer regarding data breach concerns and data protection matters, with contact details provided.
context: Contact our Data Protection Officer: dpo@firstuk.bank

name: Account Opening Process
aliases: How do I open an account
description: Guidance on opening a FirstUK Bank account through online, telephone, or postal channels. Customers can initiate account opening via the online portal or by calling the customer service line.
context: Visit www.firstuk.bank/open-account to start online (fastest), or call 0800-555-2265.
Choose a product (SmartSaver, Current, or Mortgage) and click "Open Account."

name: Account Activation Timeline
aliases: When can I use my account
description: Specifies the timeframe for account activation depending on the opening method. Online and branch accounts are immediately available, while postal applications take 5–7 days.
context: Immediately after opening (online/branch), or 5–7 days (postal).

Immediately after opening (online/branch)
